description: The published identity of a map: what it is called, who made it, which version it is, and every asset file it ships, keyed by content hash.

MapName.title: MapName
MapName.description: The name the map is published and downloaded under.

Author.title: Author
Author.description: The name the map credits as its author, which is the identity its publisher proves ownership against.

Version.title: Version
Version.description: The published version of the map, which a dependency pins and the lobby shows.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: The short introduction shown beside the map in the lobby and in the published listing.

Tags.title: Tags
Tags.description: The labels the map is discovered and filtered by.

Maintainers.title: Maintainers
Maintainers.description: The other authors allowed to publish new versions of this map.

GreenlitReferences.title: GreenlitReferences
GreenlitReferences.description: The maps this map's publication was greenlit from, kept so a derived release can be traced back.

Attribution_SourceMap.title: Attribution_SourceMap
Attribution_SourceMap.description: The maps this map's assets were imported from, kept so attribution is carried into the published listing.

IsTestVersion.title: IsTestVersion
IsTestVersion.description: Whether this publication is a test build, which is kept out of the public listing.

Assets.title: Assets
Assets.description: Every asset file the map ships, grouped by the kind of asset it is.

Animation.title: Animation
Animation.description: The map's animation files, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Building.title: Building
Building.description: The map's building models, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Character.title: Character
Character.description: The map's unit and character models, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Decal.title: Decal
Decal.description: The map's decal textures, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Icon.title: Icon
Icon.description: The map's command card icons, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: The map's item, attachment and projectile models, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Music.title: Music
Music.description: The map's music tracks, keyed by their path inside the map's audio folder and hashed by content.

Noise.title: Noise
Noise.description: The map's noise textures, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Prop.title: Prop
Prop.description: The map's prop and resource models, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Ribbon.title: Ribbon
Ribbon.description: The map's ribbon trail textures, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Shader.title: Shader
Shader.description: The map's shader configurations, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Skybox.title: Skybox
Skybox.description: The map's skyboxes, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

SoundEffect.title: SoundEffect
SoundEffect.description: The map's sound effects, keyed by their path inside the map's audio folder and hashed by content.

Spritesheet.title: Spritesheet
Spritesheet.description: The map's visual effect sprite sheets, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Terrain.title: Terrain
Terrain.description: The map's terrain textures, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

vfx_radial.title: vfx_radial
vfx_radial.description: The map's radial visual effect textures, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

vfx_vertical.title: vfx_vertical
vfx_vertical.description: The map's vertical visual effect textures, keyed by file name and hashed by content.

Other.title: Other
Other.description: The files that belong to no asset category, keyed by their map-relative path and hashed by content.
